seo_article.intro: Cognee is an open-source memory and data layer for AI applications, focused on turning data into structured, retrievable context for agents and LLM systems.
seo_article.what_it_is: Cognee is an open memory-system resource to evaluate by what it stores, how recall works, how memory is scoped, and whether users or teams can inspect, correct, export, or delete durable context.
seo_article.why_it_matters: Cognee matters because teams quickly outgrow raw prompts and scattered documents. AI applications need a way to prepare, connect, and retrieve context in a structured way.
seo_article.how_it_works: Test Cognee with repeated sessions. Add facts, update them, ask for recall, inspect retrieval behavior, and verify deletion or scoping controls before storing sensitive user or project memory.

faq.question: What should I check before using Cognee?
faq.answer: Test Cognee with repeated sessions. Add facts, update them, ask for recall, inspect retrieval behavior, and verify deletion or scoping controls before storing sensitive user or project memory.

faq.question: Is Cognee open source?
faq.answer: Cognee is listed with Apache-2.0 based on the official source links in this profile. Re-check the repository, model card, or docs before production use.
